key_terms: Managed Flink state scoped to one key of a keyed stream and one operator, so the total for east is independent of the total for west.
A keyed state primitive that holds a single value per key, checkpointed and restored by Flink.
The process function service for registering and deleting event-time or processing-time timers for the current key.
A timer that fires when the watermark passes its timestamp, not when wall-clock time passes. Sleeping in the client does not fire it.
The stable identifier, descriptor name and serializer that tie managed state to an operator across restores.
evidence: Project-only actual product commands with independent fixture oracles. Source preparation, native runtime observations and restart evidence are recorded separately in the workshop qualification ledger.
